title: Replace All Digits with Characters
summary: Given a 0-indexed string s where lowercase English letters are in the even indices and digits are in the odd indices, you are to replace each digit with the character obtained by shifting the preceding character by the digit's value.
statement: Given a 0-indexed string s where lowercase English letters are in the even indices and digits are in the odd indices, you are to replace each digit with the character obtained by shifting the preceding character by the digit's value. The shift operation, shift(c, x) , returns the character that is x positions after c in the alphabet. Ensure that the result of the shift does not exceed 'z'. Return the modified string after performing these replacements.
constraints: Even indices contain lowercase letters and odd indices contain digits.
Replace every digit by shifting its preceding letter forward that many alphabet positions; all shifts remain at most z.
hints: Each odd position depends only on the letter immediately before it.
Convert the string to a mutable list and visit odd indices.
The contract guarantees no shift exceeds z, and every digit is processed exactly once while letters remain unchanged.
editorial: The contract guarantees no shift exceeds z, and every digit is processed exactly once while letters remain unchanged.

tests.explanation: The digits shift a,c,e once to b,d,f, producing abcdef.
